body:
Finite bit-circuit construction: 192 disjoint helper pairs around the frozen PR915 target basis reduce the complete R439 word from **13,208 to 11,980 ADDs**, saving **1,228 further ADDs** after paying preparation and restoration. Against selected PR589, the reduction is **24,305 to 11,980**, or **12,325 ADDs**. No new kappa is claimed.

The complete D bill is **192 + 306 + 4,764 + 306 + 192 = 5,760 ADDs**. The actual two-sided middle matrix is rebuilt, including its 7,031-entry mixed term. Helpers are restored before A. All non-D fields, every register's ordered MOVE path, all COPY/ERASE records, nine rank-seven totals and rank mass 5,129 are retained.

The precision tradeoff is explicit: forward/reverse positive bounds become **71,907 / 10,562,318**. The local payload estimate is 102 bits; the nine-stage estimate is 192 bits, strictly below the existing ceiling and using about **99.925%** of it. Both bounds are recomputed on every admitted complete partial word. Standalone savings and predecessor bounds are not added or inherited.

Reproduce from the repository root with Python 3.12+, C++17 and Boost headers:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r439-two-sided-compensation/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/r439-two-sided-compensation/test_package.py
```

The full verifier passed on ordinary CPython 3.14.4 and isolated optimized CPython 3.12.3 from a minimal read-only source tree. Every receipt field agrees. Coverage includes all **192,282 pair scores**, independent set-valued reconstruction, **48,729 direct four-term coefficients**, 661 input columns in both D directions for all three words, original E8/frame/endpoint checks, and fresh unchanged C++ 5/9/11-stage checks on 883/1,327/1,549 formal columns per word. All **144 omitted-bridge controls**, **19 local controls** and **8 package tests** pass. The selected-record and staged whitespace checks pass. Full repository and selected-supplier cold suites are not claimed.

The original **H2 and literal K extraction remain false** for the changed word; their predicates are unchanged and explicitly reported. This requires the semantic D-boundary contract already used by PR915: arbitrary `(x,y,s)` maps to `(x,y+Ks,s)` with restored helpers. Remaining integration work is acceptance of that interface, changed whole-hosted emission and audit, full finite/precision invoice reconstruction, and outer assembly. The common-label realization and analytic assumptions remain inherited.

Base **91a2094f2e022930069e8cfdc810a3ea1b81cd09**; OS assignment seed **5**, bit-supplier track. The declared search completes one sorted disjoint greedy pass: 2,298 positive pairs, 192 accepted, 2,106 overlap skips and no bound rejects. No optimal-matching or global-circuit claim is made. A 714-open-PR refresh through #924 found no new R439 two-sided D construction. #917 concerns historical complex CK; #923 changes R439 frame520 and cleanup. Their savings are not composed here. Only `research/r439-two-sided-compensation/` is added; the frozen review batch is not edited or treated as approval.

Credit **Scott Woolsey Biggart / @swbiggart, PR733** (`dfe84e09298abc5c5e0074afda59a821e10abfb4`) for the prior two-sided method and mixed-term obligation, and **PR915** (`e9daefe320a0043000bd9746664ed02c3287d056`) for the frozen target basis. The package preserves source snapshots and notices. Credit also remains with **DreamingOfClouds, eumemic, commdata2338, Mikhail R. Gadelha, Greer Guthrie, Sagar Thakrar**, and the native verification lineage; Ross Richardson's concurrent PR917 is acknowledged. Prepared for **Gareth Davidson (@bitplane)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**. Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed.

Published head: **0f216a345c37bc71cc0e22030ef11ec31b26a69e**. Mathematical implementation: **1e9c43ee8dbeeb9aca0e8fdecbf9769db4f4a29e**; the final commit changes only the local claim to record the result and PR link. The remote OPEN state, exact head and 24-file package scope were verified. All five hosted workflows at the published head report **`action_required`**; no hosted CI pass is claimed. [Research-artifact workflow](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38402676713). An immediate post-submission refresh also found #925 (R439 phase-A frame267) and #927 (historical ranking reconciliation), both distinct from this D construction.
title: Finite bit construction: two-sided R439 compensation saves 1,228 more ADDs beyond PR915
